title: AccessKey
description: media.access-key@1 (ADR-031, amended 2026-10-14): one S3 access key of OpenVibe.Media's S3 surface (https://s3.openvibe.media). It is bound to one project environment, reads and/or writes, and may be scoped to some zones of that environment (zone.object-zone@1 ids; empty means every zone). Media issues and verifies it: SigV4 needs the secret, so the party that checks signatures keeps it, encrypted, and shows it once (media.access-key-issued@1). The secret is never part of this record. A revoked key is refused at once; a key scoped only to a zone that is deleted is revoked with it. More fields may be added.

name.description: What uses the key, as the person who issued it named it.

zones.description: The zones it may reach; empty = every zone of the environment.

last_used_at.description: The last signed request, to the minute.
